source.check: returned unopposed: read on the BNA page image, after Benburb (Roulstone) and Clonaneese (Marshall) 'returned unopposed for Dungannon Rural Council', the paragraph ends 'Minterburn—Moses Busby'; he sits on the Technical Instruction Committee at the new council's statutory meeting (Mid-Ulster Mail, 10 June 1933, p. 5, image read)

note: Triennial election of the Dungannon rural district councillors, 1933. Nominations were received on 18 April 1933 and 'there will be no contests in any of the divisions' (Belfast News-Letter, 19 April 1933, p. 14). No poll was held; Tyrone's polling day was Wednesday 31 May 1933. The Armagh Guardian (21 April 1933, p. 2) lists Moses Busby for Minterburn among the members returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
